titleInfo.title: Band of brothers
titleInfo.subTitle: E Company, 506th Regiment, 101st Airborne : from Normandy to Hitler's Eagle's nest

physicalDescription.extent: 335 p., [8] p. of plates : ill., maps ; 24 cm.

abstract.#text: "As good a rifle company as any in the world. Easy Company, 506th Airborne Division, U.S. Army, kept getting the tough assignments responsible for everything from parachuting into France early D-Day morning to the capture of Hitler's Eagle's Nest at Berchtesgaden. Ambrose tells of the men in this brave unit who fought, went hungry,froze, and died, a company that took 150 percent casualties and considered the Purple Heart a badge of office." -- Back cover.

tableOfContents.#text: Ch. 1. "We Wanted Those Wings"; Camp Toccoa, July-December 1942 -- Ch. 2. "Stand Up and Hook Up"; Benning, Mackall, Bragg, Shanks, December 1942-September 1943 -- Ch. 3. "Duties of the Latrine Orderly"; Aldbourne, September 1943-March 1944 -- Ch. 4. "Look Out Hitler! Here We Come!"; Slapton Sands, Uppottery, April 1-June 5, 1944 -- Ch. 5. "Follow Me"; Normandy, June 6, 1944 -- Ch. 6. "Move Out!"; Carentan, June 7-July 12, 1944 -- Ch. 7. Healing Wounds and Scrubbed Missions; Aldbourne, July 13-September 16, 1944 -- Ch. 8. "Hell's Highway"; Holland, September 17-October 1, 1944 -- Ch. 9. The Island; Holland, October 2-November 25, 1944 -- Ch. 10. Resting, Recovering, and Refitting; Mourmelon-le-Grand, November 26-December 18, 1944 -- Ch. 11. "They Got Us Surrounded--the Poor Bastards"; Bastogne, December 19-31, 1944 -- Ch. 12. The Breaking Point; Bastogne, January 1-13, 1945 -- Ch. 13. Attack; Noville, January 14-17, 1945 -- Ch. 14. The Patrol; Haguenau, January 18-February 23, 1945 -- Ch. 15. "The Best Feeling in the World"; Mourmelon, February 25-April 2, 1945 -- Ch. 16. Getting to Know the Enemy; Germany, April 2-30, 1945 -- Ch. 17. Drinking Hitler's Champagne; Berchtesgaden, May 1-8, 1945 -- Ch. 18. The Soldier's Dream Life; Austria, May 8-July 31, 1945 -- Ch. 19. Postwar Careers; 1945-1991.

abstract.#text: The story of Easy Company of the US Army Airbourne Paratrooper division and their mission in WWII France during Operation Overlord.

tableOfContents.#text: disc 1. pt. 1 Currahee. pt. 2 Day of days -- disc 2. pt. 3 Carentan. pt. 4 Replacements -- disc 3. pt. 5 Crossroads. pt. 6 Bastogne -- disc 4. pt. 7 The breaking point. pt. 8 The last patrol -- disc 5. pt. 9 Why we fight. pt. 10 Points -- disc 6. Bonus features.

note: Based on the book by Stephen E. Ambrose.
